name: Common Variable Immunodeficiency without Known Genetic Defect

criteria.description: Marked decrease of serum IgG and IgA with or without low IgM
Impaired antibody response to vaccines or natural infections
Exclusion of other defined causes of hypogammaglobulinemia and secondary immunodeficiencies
Onset of immunodeficiency after 2 years of age
Recurrent bacterial infections, especially of respiratory tract

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of marked hypogammaglobulinemia (low IgG and IgA) with poor vaccine response and exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may be negative or inconclusive; diagnosis is clinical and immunological.

searchTerms: frequent lung and sinus bacterial infections

common.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea due to gastrointestinal infections or inflammation
searchTerms: chronic loose stools due to gut inflammation

common.symptomName: Autoimmune cytopenias (e.g., autoimmune hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia)
searchTerms: blood cell destruction by immune system

occasional.symptomName: Granulomatous disease affecting lungs or other organs
searchTerms: granuloma formation in lungs or organs

occasional.symptomName: Chronic fatigue related to immune dysfunction
searchTerms: chronic exhaustion linked to immune problems

rare.symptomName: Neurological complications such as peripheral neuropathy

rare.notes: Note: hepatic is not in valid body systems; omit or reclassify

laboratory: Low serum immunoglobulin levels (IgG, IgA, often IgM)
Poor or absent antibody response to vaccines
Normal or reduced B cell counts; variable T cell abnormalities
imaging: Chest CT showing bronchiectasis or interstitial lung disease
Lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly on ultrasound or CT
genetic: No known pathogenic genetic defect identified in majority of cases
other: Flow cytometry for B cell subsets abnormalities

distinguishingFeatures: History of immunosuppressive therapy or malignancy
Elevated or normal IgM with low IgG and IgA
Defects in CD40L or related pathways

redFlags: Severe recurrent bacterial infections requiring hospitalization
Failure to respond to standard antibiotic therapy
Development of bronchiectasis or chronic lung disease
references: ESID Registry - Diagnostic Criteria for CVID
